gloss: minced meat cutlet; ground meat croquette

definitions.gloss: minced meat cutlet; ground meat croquette
definitions.explanation: A deep-fried breaded patty made from seasoned ground meat (usually beef, pork, or a mix), onions, and other ingredients. A popular item in Japanese home cooking and at butcher shops.

examples.japanese: メンチカツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{肉屋|にくや}→肉屋：15233_nikuya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{揚|あ}げたて→揚げたて：16736_agetate⟧メンチカツ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧だ。
examples.english: Freshly fried menchi-katsu from the butcher shop is the best.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{晩|ばん}ご{飯|はん}→晩ご飯：02940_bangohan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧メンチカツ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}って→思う：00492_omou⟧、⟦{挽肉|ひきにく}→挽肉：14783_hikiniku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧ねぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きた。
examples.english: I decided to make homemade menchi-katsu for dinner tonight, so I bought ground meat and onions.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
メンチカツ is a staple of Japanese yōshoku (Western-style) cuisine. It is commonly sold at butcher shops (⟦{肉屋|にくや}→肉屋：15233_nikuya⟧) and ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧ (deli) counters. The name comes from English "minced" + "cutlet."

SIMILAR FOODS:
- ⟦コロッケ→コロッケ：10857_korokke⟧ (croquette — made with potato rather than meat)
- ⟦ハンバーグ→ハンバーグ：01785_hanbaagu⟧ (Hamburg steak — similar meat patty but not breaded or fried)
- ⟦とんかつ→とんかつ：28094_tonkatsu⟧ (pork cutlet — a whole cut of pork, not ground)
